scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the linearization, characteristic factor, frequency polynomial, Theorem 2.1, phase equations, Theorem 3.1, transversality calculation, numerical parameters, and discussion. The publisher record was checked for date and primary MSC. The extension is derived analytically from the unique frequency, complete phase repetitions, and repeated positive crossing direction; a standalone numerical replay checks the source example. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result classifies linear characteristic roots for the rat-free equilibrium under c<g, a<b, and 0<h<b/3. It does not classify nonlinear periodic-orbit stability after later crossings or extend the conclusion to neutral delay equations.

title: No restabilization and an exact unstable-root ladder in a delayed invasive-species model
